name: Portkey
desc: AI gateway sitting between your app and every model
desc_zh: 挡在应用与模型之间的 AI 网关
solves: One provider having a bad afternoon, or one key overrunning its budget, takes the whole app down. Routing in front does not.
solves_zh: 一家供应商状态变差，或者一个 key 超了预算，整个应用跟着挂。前置的路由不会。
best_for: Model calls across several vendors that need fallbacks, rate limits and a cost breakdown.
best_for_zh: 模型调用横跨多家供应商，需要的是 fallback、限流和一份成本明细。
notes: Managed alternative to building the same control plane yourself. 首次公开发布日期精度：month-only 来源：https://www.portkey.ai/portkey-ai-info-page 2026-11-25：date_precision day → month。官方信息页写的是「Launch March 2023」。按月份精度记 2026-11-25：status active → renamed; superseded_by null → prisma-airs-ai-gateway。Portkey 被 Palo Alto Networks 收购后并入 Prisma AIRS；Portkey 官网横幅写「Portkey is now PRISMA AIRS AI Gateway, generally available for all enterprises」。按改名规则，旧名档案指向新名字的档案
